bessel.Bessel.time_grad_log_kv.code:
class Bessel:
    def time_grad_log_kv(self, regime: str) -> None:
        gv, gz = self._grad(self.v, self.z)
        gv.block_until_ready()
        gz.block_until_ready()

    def setup(self, regime: str) -> None:
        require_requested_device()
        v, z, z_lo, z_hi = _REGIMES[regime]
        self.v = jnp.asarray(v, dtype=jnp.float64)
        self.z = jnp.asarray(z, dtype=jnp.float64)
        self.v_batch = jnp.full(_BATCH, v, dtype=jnp.float64)
        self.z_batch = jnp.linspace(z_lo, z_hi, _BATCH, dtype=jnp.float64)
    
        self._eval = jax.jit(_log_kv)
        self._eval_batch = jax.jit(jax.vmap(_log_kv))
        self._grad = jax.jit(jax.grad(_log_kv, argnums=(0, 1)))
    
        self._eval(self.v, self.z).block_until_ready()
        self._eval_batch(self.v_batch, self.z_batch).block_until_ready()
        gv, gz = self._grad(self.v, self.z)
        gv.block_until_ready()
        gz.block_until_ready()
bessel.Bessel.time_grad_log_kv.name: bessel.Bessel.time_grad_log_kv

em.EMIteration.time_fit.code:
class EMIteration:
    def time_fit(self, dist: str) -> None:
        result = self.init.fit(self.X, max_iter=_ITERS, tol=0.0)
        block_pytree(result.model)

    def setup(self, dist: str) -> None:
        require_requested_device()
        truth = _DISTS[dist]()
        X = truth.rvs(_EM_N, seed=_EM_SEED)
        block_pytree(X)
        init = _moment_init(type(truth), X)
        self.init = init
        self.X = X
        result = init.fit(X, max_iter=_ITERS, tol=0.0)
        block_pytree(result.model)
em.EMIteration.time_fit.name: em.EMIteration.time_fit

em.EStep.time_conditional_expectations.code:
class EStep:
    def time_conditional_expectations(
        self, dist: str, backend: str, n: int
    ) -> None:
        eta = self.model.e_step(self.X, backend=backend)
        block_pytree(eta)

    def setup(self, dist: str, backend: str, n: int) -> None:
        require_requested_device()
        model = _DISTS[dist]()
        X = model.rvs(int(n), seed=_EM_SEED)
        block_pytree(X)
        self.model = model
        self.X = X
        eta = model.e_step(X, backend=backend)
        block_pytree(eta)
